title: Explain Like I'm 5
prompt_template: Explain {concept} like I'm 5 years old. Use simple analogies and avoid jargon.
description: Makes complex topics accessible for any audience.

title: Code Refactor
prompt_template:
Refactor the following {language} code to improve readability and efficiency. Provide the updated code and explain the changes.

```
{code}
```
description: Asks the AI to clean up and optimize code.

title: Fantasy World Builder
prompt_template: Create a detailed description of a fantasy world called {world_name}. Include geography, magic system, political factions, and a unique creation myth.
description: Generates rich lore for worldbuilding.

title: Meeting Summarizer
description: Turns meeting transcripts into structured summaries.

title: Debugging Partner
prompt_template:
I'm getting this error in my {language} code:
```
{error_message}
```
Here's the relevant snippet:
```
{code}
```
Explain what's causing the error and suggest a fix.
description: Helps diagnose programming errors.

title: Poetry Generator
prompt_template: Write a {style} poem about {topic}. The poem should be 12 lines long and use vivid imagery.
description: Creates custom poetry in a chosen style.

title: SQL Query Writer
prompt_template: Write a SQL query to {task}. The database has tables: {tables}. Return only the query without explanation.
description: Generates SQL queries from plain English.

title: Job Interview Coach
prompt_template: Simulate a job interview for a {position} role. Ask me 10 common questions, and after each answer, give feedback on my response.
description: Interactive interview practice with AI feedback.

title: News Summarizer
description: Extracts key facts from news articles.

title: Cold Email Generator
prompt_template: Write a cold email to a potential client in the {industry} industry. Our service is {service}. Keep it under 200 words, friendly, and with a clear call to action.
description: Creates effective outreach emails.

title: DSA Concept Explainer
prompt_template: Explain the data structure/algorithm {concept} in simple terms. Include: how it works, time complexity, common use cases, and a short pseudocode example.
description: Perfect for last‑minute DSA revision before interviews.

title: Code Optimizer
prompt_template:
Analyze the following {language} code for performance bottlenecks. Suggest 3 optimizations with code snippets and explain the trade-offs.

```
{code}
```
description: Helps you write efficient code for competitive programming & projects.

title: LeetCode Problem Solver
prompt_template: Solve this LeetCode problem: {problem_statement}. Provide the approach, time/space complexity, and a clean {language} solution with comments.
description: Your personal CP assistant – breaks down any DSA problem.

title: Capstone Project Idea Generator
prompt_template: Suggest 5 innovative BTech capstone project ideas in {domain} (e.g., AI, IoT, blockchain). For each, include a problem statement, tech stack, and feasibility note.
description: Overcome project idea block with tailored, implementable suggestions.

title: Research Paper Summarizer
description: Quickly digest papers for literature surveys or assignments.

title: Mathematics Problem Solver
prompt_template: Solve this engineering math problem step‑by‑step: {problem}. Explain each step and the underlying concept. Topic: {topic} (e.g., linear algebra, calculus).
description: Covers calculus, linear algebra, probability – essential for sem exams.

title: Circuit Analysis Helper
prompt_template: Analyze the given circuit: {circuit_description}. Find current/voltage using {method} (KVL/KCL, Thevenin, etc.). Show all steps and final values.
description: Electrical/electronics students can debug circuits with AI guidance.

title: Machine Learning Model Selector
prompt_template: I have a dataset with {features} and need to predict {target}. Suggest 3 ML models (with pros/cons) and recommend the best one with Python code skeleton.
description: Ideal for BTech AI/ML projects or hackathons.

title: Exam Cram Notes Creator
prompt_template: Create ultra‑condensed revision notes on {subject_topic} for a BTech exam. Use bullet points, important formulas, and mnemonics. Max 200 words.
description: Turn weeks of lectures into a single‑page cheat sheet.

title: Group Discussion Simulator
prompt_template: Simulate a group discussion on the topic '{topic}' for a campus placement. I'll give my opening statement, then you act as other candidates and moderate. Provide feedback at the end.
description: Practice GD rounds with an AI moderator and opponents.

title: Resume Bullet Enhancer
description: Tailored for BTech students applying to internships/jobs.

title: Viva Question Predictor
prompt_template: Generate 10 viva‑voce questions a professor might ask for a BTech project on '{project_title}'. Include answers and key concepts to revise.
description: Walk into your final viva fully prepared.

title: Signals & Systems Solver
prompt_template: Find the Fourier/Laplace/Z‑transform of {signal}. Show the step‑by‑step mathematical derivation and mention the ROC.
description: Essential for ECE/EE students struggling with transforms.

title: Internship Cold Email
prompt_template: Write a cold email to a {company_type} startup asking for a {domain} internship. Mention my skills: {skills}. Keep it under 150 words and humble.
description: Land your dream internship with a polished, personalized pitch.

title: Algorithm Dry‑Run Visualizer
prompt_template: Dry‑run the algorithm {algorithm_name} on this input: {input_data}. Show each iteration, variable changes, and final output in a structured table.
description: Understand how sorting/graph/tree algorithms execute step‑by‑step.

title: Time‑Table Optimizer
prompt_template: Create a weekly study plan for a BTech student preparing for {exams/subjects}. Allocate 5 hours daily, include breaks, and prioritize tough topics.
description: Beat procrastination with a realistic, AI‑crafted schedule.

title: Bug Report Decoder
prompt_template: Explain this error message in simple terms: `{error_log}`. What caused it? Suggest 3 possible fixes and how to prevent it in the future.
description: Decode cryptic compiler/runtime errors instantly.

title: Literature Survey Assistant
prompt_template: For a BTech project on {topic}, list 5 recent papers (2022+) with a one‑line summary each. Also mention open research gaps.
description: Quick start your literature review without drowning in Google Scholar.

title: Seminar Script Writer
prompt_template: Write a 5‑minute seminar script on {topic} for a BTech audience. Include an engaging opening, key points, and a memorable conclusion.
description: Ace your next technical presentation with a ready‑made script.

title: Placement Aptitude Trainer
prompt_template: Generate 5 aptitude questions on {topic} (e.g., probability, time‑speed, puzzles) with detailed solutions. Mimic the style of campus placement tests.
description: Practice quant & reasoning for TCS, Infosys, etc.

title: Design Pattern Explainer
prompt_template: Explain the {design_pattern} design pattern with a real‑world analogy, a UML diagram description, and a {language} code example.
description: Master software design patterns for interviews & clean architecture.

title: Thermodynamics Problem Solver
prompt_template: Solve this thermodynamics problem: {problem}. Use {law/formula} and show all unit conversions. Explain the physical meaning of the result.
description: Mechanical/chemical engineering students – get step‑wise solutions.

title: Git Command Troubleshooter
prompt_template: I'm stuck with this Git issue: `{error_or_situation}`. Explain what went wrong and give the exact commands to fix it.
description: Resolve merge conflicts, detached HEAD, and other Git nightmares.

title: Mini‑Project Documentation Generator
prompt_template: Generate a project report outline for a BTech mini‑project titled '{project_title}'. Include: abstract, system architecture, implementation details, results, and future scope.
description: Save hours on documentation with a structured template.

title: Essay/Assignment Outline
prompt_template: Create a detailed outline for a 1000‑word essay on '{topic}'. Include thesis statement, main arguments, supporting evidence, and a counter‑argument section.
description: Perfect for humanities/social science assignments in engineering.
